column1: # GENERATED by hc-conformance --write-evidence-cards. Maps each conformance/dataflow-obligations.tsv
# cell_id to the Markdown card that renders it under conformance/evidence-cards/ -- file names are
# a truncated, sanitized slug of the cell id plus a stable content hash (cell ids contain ':'/'.'
# /'->' and can exceed Windows path-length limits verbatim), so this index is the lookup a
# human or gate uses instead of reconstructing the file name by hand.
